# graviteeam_form (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM Form (custom login, registration, and other page templates)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_form" "example" {
  domain_id = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  template  = "LOGIN"
  enabled   = true
  content   = "<html><body><h1>Welcome</h1></body></html>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The HTML content of the form (supports Thymeleaf expressions)
- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain this form belongs to
- `template` (String) The template type (e.g. LOGIN, REGISTRATION, FORGOT_PASSWORD, etc.)

### Optional

- `application_id` (String) The ID of the application (for app-level override). If not set, the form applies at domain level.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the custom form is enabled

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the form
